fields.quoted_span: Rent may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage
fields.note: The document supports the once-per-12-months rule, the removal of the utility and dependent add-ons, the 10% non-dependent tenant allowance within 60 days, the LAHD-approval programs, the market-rate reset triggers, the $1.61 and $3.00 surcharges, and the moratorium dates. It does not state the 3% rate, which is in a linked PDF. It does not give the $2.83 SCEP amount, only 1/12 of 50% of the annual fee. It does not mention the state 30-day notice rule.

fields.quoted_span: Generally, the RSO applies to rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978, as well as replacement units under
fields.note: The document supports the 1978 cutoff, replacement units under LAMC 151.28, the covered property types, the hotel and rooming house 30-day condition, the condominium and townhome 1995 limit, the luxury exemption and temporary exemptions. The claim that RSO units are outside the state AB 1482 cap is not in this document.
The document never cites L.A. Mun. Code § 151.06. It cites only LAMC Section 151.28 (replacement units) and 151.09.C.9 (eviction notice filing), plus RAC Regs and Ord. No. 187,108.
